headline: NY high sheet frozen since 15:20 ET 11-15 and the NY low has had no prediction since 15:25 ET, behind green runs: cbffb3a86 dropped ['hourly'] at kalshi_daily.py:1945, so the forecast history is empty and the high returns early. The one-line fix is on this branch (replay: 0 to 40 days per model); merge before 08:00 ET for the low lock and before noon for the high lock.

findings.title: High bake silently stopped; low has no forecast
findings.evidence: kalshi_ny.json updated_utc 2026-11-15T20:21:38Z; ny_high trail ends 15:20 ET, 11-16 trail 404; run 43844907156 log 'not enough scored history for a bias (0 days)', 'ny_high done in 10s', no FAILED; ny_low trail pred/pick null from 20:25Z; cause kalshi_daily.py:1945 absorb(_archive_json(u)) without ['hourly'] (cbffb3a86, pushed 20:22Z); replay 0 -> 40 days per model

findings.title: Watchdog blind to a market that returns early
findings.evidence: worker status healthy:true at 10:08Z; run_market 'return 0' (kalshi_daily.py:4438) prints no FAILED; a stale updated_utc check on kalshi_ny.json would have paged at 20:51Z
